correctness.rationale: The sole homology degree and rank are taken from the exact prior cycle theorems. The signed orbit-face Lefschetz identity follows from the sign of permutation of an oriented simplex. A 4-state automaton gives T^5=-I and exact rotation traces for every period. Folding a reflected polygon gives explicit endpoint-forbidden strings, whose signed sums obey F(L+5)=-F(L); five finite seeds in each axis case finish reflection traces. Group averaging gives the mod-20 quotient result. The independent exhaustive face-sign trace check verifies all 174 group elements for lengths 12 to 17; finite computation is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The four-run-free cycle complex is a canonical first case beyond the already studied three-run-free family, and its full dihedral representation is not determined by known sphere ranks. A complete all-length character and sharp mod-20 quotient cohomology classification expose a genuine symmetry-sensitive invariant, including vanishing of every invariant class at multiples of five and even lengths. This is an infinite natural classification, not a numerically arbitrary slice.
